queries: Fred Ehrsam ChatGPT January 13 2023 4 21 kilometer mile conversion

sources_considered.why: Original public endorsement and date were readable; the response image was not transcribed.
Contemporary account explicitly describes the numerical answer in the embedded tweet.
Also reports 6:52, but the earlier account is preferable and this page contains later updates.
Authoritative definitions permit an independent calculation.

evidence_items.locator: Section “We don’t need Google anymore!”, paragraph immediately after the embedded tweet
evidence_items.explanation: This contemporary transcription identifies the erroneous answer. Applying the NIST definitions gives 420.038784 seconds per mile, which rounds to 7:00 rather than 6:52.

inputs: Reported input pace: 4 minutes 21 seconds per kilometre.
NIST section B.6: an international mile equals 5280 international feet.
NIST section B.6: an international foot equals 0.3048 metres.
derived.rounding: Nearest whole second: 420 seconds, or 7 minutes 00 seconds.

receipt.public_excerpt: ChatGPT delivers a precise and concise answer.

evidence_items.explanation: The original tweet confirms that Ehrsam publicly praised the answer’s precision. It does not establish what checks he privately attempted.

evidence_items.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
evidence_items.locator: Section B.6, U.S. survey foot and mile
evidence_items.explanation: The section records the international foot definition and the 5280-foot international mile. These supply the conversion constants; they are not observations of ChatGPT.

unresolved_gaps: The original response image was not recoverable as text; its numerical content rests on a contemporary secondary account.
No evidence establishes Ehrsam’s private checking process or motivation.
